name: Media Server Uptime Monitor
description: Checks Plex and Jellyfin services every five minutes and restarts them if they stopped responding.

config.command: systemctl is-active plexmediaserver || systemctl restart plexmediaserver

error_handler.title: Plex restart failed
error_handler.body: plexmediaserver could not be restarted on media-01

config.command: systemctl is-active jellyfin || systemctl restart jellyfin

error_handler.title: Jellyfin restart failed
error_handler.body: jellyfin could not be restarted on media-02

error_handler.title: Plex not responding
error_handler.body: Plex HTTP endpoint did not respond on media-01

config.title: Media services healthy
config.body: Plex and Jellyfin are running normally
